title: Benchmarking PDF Accessibility Evaluation: A Dataset and Framework for Assessing Automated and LLM-Based Approaches for Accessibility Testing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on 'Cannot Tell' scenarios where necessary information (such as alternative text or font metadata) is deliberately withheld to observe the models' default classification tendencies (e.g., an optimistic bias toward 'Passed' or a conservative bias toward 'Failed').
